mgmt_pain_2_title: Four files, none up to date
mgmt_pain_2_text: The crew list, the car roles, the pit stop crew, the meals: each in its own file, and none of them the latest.

logi_pain_1_text: The logistics sheet is rebuilt and sent again at every change. By Thursday, three versions are going round the crew.
logi_pain_2_text: The agency's mails, the hotel's PDF, the rental confirmation, a spreadsheet: each on someone else's laptop.
logi_pain_3_text: Mechanics, engineers and drivers ask you one by one, all week, then again on the way to the circuit.
logi_pain_title: One flight moves. Six people need to know.
logi_f1_title: Your full crew, their complete logistics, one view.
logi_f1_text: Departure, hotel, return and on-site vehicle, one row per person. Select several people to book a shared trip or hotel at once.
logi_f2_title: Hotels, rooms, and rooming lists. Handled.
logi_f2_text: Hotels, rooms and who sleeps where, with check-in and check-out. Attach the confirmation: the crew downloads it from their app.
logi_f3_title: Every journey planned, every seat assigned.
logi_f3_text: Departure and return by plane, train, bus or team vehicle, split into legs, each with its people and its tickets.
logi_f4_title: Fleet vehicles and rentals, ready for the road.
logi_f4_text: Your own fleet and this weekend's rentals, used for travel and for the daily transfers at the circuit.
logi_f5_title: The briefing board, shared with everyone.
logi_f5_text: Where the trucks park, where the passes are, what to do if you arrive after 22:00: notes the crew reads in the app.

logi_sync_daily_text: The vehicle that takes them to the circuit, and who rides along.

tt_cta_title: Plan your next weekend, minute by minute.
tt_hero_title: Your race weekend, minute by minute.
tt_hero_lede: Build your team's schedule around the official sessions, set recurring briefings once, and put a live countdown on the screen in your box. Everyone knows where to be, and when.
tt_hero_alt: RaceNode timetable software showing a racing team's schedule alongside the official sessions
tt_pain_1_text: A new spreadsheet for every event, copied from the last one, out of date the moment the official schedule shifts.
tt_pain_2_title: Briefings lost in the group chat
tt_pain_2_text: Setup windows, briefings, and departure times sent by message — then buried under the next fifty notifications.
tt_pain_3_text: Everyone asking the same questions all weekend because there's no single, live view of the plan.
tt_pain_title: The schedule is the plan. Yet it lives everywhere but one place.
tt_f1_title: Your schedule, next to the official one.
tt_f1_text: The organizer's sessions and your team's items in one table, day by day, with a countdown to each. Aim an item at the roles, groups or people it concerns: everyone gets their own slice. Flip to a calendar to drag and resize; export to Excel or CSV.
tt_f2_text: Track walk, briefings, pit setup: saved once with their type, place and duration. Start typing on the schedule and they fill themselves in.
tt_f3_title: Anchor to the sessions. Let the rest follow.
tt_f3_text: "Car by car briefing, 60 minutes before each session": one rule creates the items across the weekend. When a session moves, its items move with it, without duplicates.
tt_f4_title: Drop the organizer's PDF. Check it. It's filled in.
tt_f4_text: Drop the official timetable on the event: its sessions come out as rows to check, then fill the event's programme. Nothing is saved before you confirm.
tt_f4_small: PDF, Excel, .ics, a picture or a screenshot… up to 10 MB.
tt_features_title: One schedule, built around the official one.
tt_share_1: Big-screen display with live per-session countdowns
tt_share_2: iCal feed for phones and calendar apps
tt_share_3: One link per event, revoke it anytime
tt_share_title: Put the countdown on the wall.
tt_share_lede: Cast the display page to the TV in your box: every session with a live countdown. Or give the team one iCal link.
tt_share_alt: RaceNode public timetable display with live countdowns to each session
tt_sync_next_text: The next items of the day with a countdown, rolling over on its own as the weekend runs.
tt_sync_all_text: One tap opens the whole timetable.
tt_sync_current_text: Change the schedule once: the phones show the new time, no new PDF to send.
tt_sync_title: Everyone sees what's next, in real time.
tt_sync_lede: The timetable you build is the one each person carries in the RaceNode app. Here, a chief mechanic's race weekend.
plan_hero_title: The whole season. Who is where, day by day.
plan_hero_alt: RaceNode planning software showing a racing team's whole season on one grid
plan_pain_1_text: The season rota is an Excel file on the team manager's laptop. Nobody else can edit it, and nobody ever has the latest version.
plan_pain_2_text: Assign someone to an event, then retype the same days in the planning. Forget one of the two and they quietly drift apart.
plan_pain_3_text: Who's off in August? Who can do the test day? The answers live in forty chat threads, and they change after you've planned.
plan_pain_4_text: Racecars and trucks have a season too. The spreadsheet only ever tracked the people.
plan_pain_title: The season is planned. In a file only one person can touch.
plan_f1_text: Days across, people grouped by role, championships on top, racecars and trucks below. From a week to the whole year, with the days worked counted on each row.
plan_f2_text: Paint the days: on track, travelling, workshop, remote, unavailable. Every change saves itself and can be undone.
plan_f3_title: The truck loads early. The engineer stays late.
plan_f3_text: Resize a bar to set when that person, car or truck is really there. The event's dates stay as they are.
plan_sync_lede_both: The grid isn't only written by the manager. Every team member posts their own days in their planning, and what they post lands in yours.
plan_sync_lede_one: The days you plan for each person show up in their own season, in the RaceNode app.
plan_card_1_text: A member posts a week away and it lands in your grid as unavailable: dates only, their reasons stay their own.
plan_card_2_text: The days you plan for someone show up in their own season view, with your note. No forwarded screenshots of a spreadsheet.
plan_card_3_text: Assigning someone to an event is the planning entry: track days derive from it, and follow when the event's dates move.
plan_agenda_alt: RaceNode Planning (Me view) on a phone - a crew member's season in Agenda view
plan_agenda_caption: Their side: the season as an agenda — what is coming, in order.
plan_month_alt: RaceNode Planning (Me view) on a phone - a crew member's season in Month view
plan_month_caption: The same season as a month — events, travel, and the days they posted.
plan_sync_chase: No availability emails to chase, no spreadsheet versions to reconcile.
